item.title: Cycle 1 · Establishing the Entropy Project
item.description:
We are initiating our first project focused on the topic of entropy, specifically looking at the relationships and distinctions between thermodynamic, statistical-mechanical, and information-theoretic formulations. We will query foundational literature to map these domains.
